typeProperties.script:
parameters{
	BossDatabase as string (),
	BossPassword as string (),
	BossServer as string (),
	BossUserId as string (),
	strSqlServerProvider as string (),
	WarpLoadDatabase as string (),
	WarpLoadDataSource as string (),
	WarploadPassword as string (),
	WarpLoadServer as string (),
	WarploadUserId as string ()
}

source(output(
		WLP_COMPANY as string,
		WLP_MBU as string,
		WLP_PROD as string,
		FAC_GRP as string,
		FAC_CLASS as string,
		FAC_PLAN as string,
		FUNDING_CD as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	ignoreNoFilesFound: false) ~> FundingCDMAPPING
FundingCDMAPPING derive({Copy of FAC_CLASS} = toString(FAC_CLASS),
		{Copy of WLP_PROD} = toString(WLP_PROD),
		{Copy of FAC_GRP} = toString(FAC_GRP),
		{Copy of FAC_PLAN} = toString(FAC_PLAN),
		{Copy of WLP_COMPANY} = toString(WLP_COMPANY),
		{Copy of FUNDING_CD} = toString(FUNDING_CD),
		{Copy of WLP_MBU} = toString(WLP_MBU)) ~> DataConversion
DataConversion sink(input(
		WLP_COMPANY as string,
		FAC_GRP as string,
		FAC_CLASS as string,
		WLP_PROD as string,
		FUNDING_CD as string,
		FAC_PLAN as string,
		WLP_MBU as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	stagingSchemaName: 'dbo',
	saveOrder: 10000,
	insertable:true,
	deletable:false,
	upsertable:false,
	updateable:false,
	keys:[],
	mapColumn(
		WLP_COMPANY = {Copy of WLP_COMPANY},
		FAC_GRP = {Copy of FAC_GRP},
		FAC_CLASS = {Copy of FAC_CLASS},
		WLP_PROD = {Copy of WLP_PROD},
		FUNDING_CD = {Copy of FUNDING_CD},
		FAC_PLAN = {Copy of FAC_PLAN},
		WLP_MBU = {Copy of WLP_MBU})) ~> UpdateFundingCD
